headline: Recipe for a successful launch

result.label: Year-over-year sales increase
result.note: Published on the StreetPulse page of millergroup.com

summary: Everyone assumed a pricing problem. StreetPulse showed the real gap was a missing value story — and the “Ask Gelson’s” campaign told it across outdoor, streaming radio, social and in-store.

question.h: A premium brand, an underperforming store.
question.p: Gelson’s, a 28-store upscale regional grocery chain ranked #4 nationally by Consumer Reports, wanted to generate buzz for its newest West LA location. Known for curated selections, award-winning service, and top-quality fresh and center store items, Gelson’s needed a launch that matched its premium brand — and needed to understand why the location was underperforming.

found.h: Not price, not signage — a missing value story.
found.p: StreetPulse put the question to shoppers on camera. The real story behind the underperforming location was not price or a lack of signage — it was a missing value story.

made.p: We created Ask Gelson’s — a multi-channel campaign spanning outdoor, streaming radio, paid and organic social, and weekly in-store events. To amplify visibility, we recommended bold, building-side graphics as a standout awareness driver and weekly farmers markets in the courtyard for the building’s tenants.

happened.p: The fix drove a 6% year-over-year sales increase — the loop ran whole: consumers revealed the gap, strategy reframed it, creative shipped it.

quote.text: The Miller Group is smart, collaborative, and conscientious. Fantastic research, good creative chops and a solid understanding of our goals, coupled with the ability to make strategic recommendations in social, online, digital, CTV + OTT.
quote.short: Smart, collaborative, and conscientious. Fantastic research, good creative chops.
quote.name: Yvonne Manganaro

rationale: The flagship. Under the new positioning the money shot isn’t the 6% — it’s that the problem they hired you for was not the problem. The four-block structure (question → found → made → happened) is the site’s case format; it turns every Challenge/Solution write-up into evidence for “we find out, then we build.”
